headlessFlag.note: No headless flag exists; a positional prompt starts a task. The -p flag means plan mode, not print.

evidence.locator: Help Menu, prompt argument; Commands, cline (default)
Global Options, --json row; JSON Output Format
Global Options, --thinking row (none, low, medium, high, xhigh)

permissionDefault.note: In ACP mode the default is false.

guidance.text: A plain prompt runs in act mode with every tool auto-approved. Pass --auto-approve false or -p (plan mode) when the run must not change files.
Set reasoning effort per run with --thinking none, low, medium, high, or xhigh; the default is medium.
CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS takes JSON allow and deny glob lists to restrict shell commands. Deny wins, and redirects stay blocked unless allowRedirects is true.
There is no timeout by default (-t 0). Set -t seconds so a stuck headless run ends, and use --json for line-delimited machine-readable messages.
